name: NSFDC Micro Credit Finance Scheme (MCS)
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment (MoSJE)
implementingAgency: National Scheduled Castes Finance and Development Corporation (NSFDC)
targetAudience: Scheduled Caste individuals, small artisans, petty shopkeepers, street vendors
briefDescription: Concessional micro-credit assistance up to ₹1.40 Lakh for small income-generating activities and self-employment ventures.
detailedBenefits: Provides up to 90% of project cost, maximum ₹1,40,000
Very low interest rate of 5% - 6% p.a.
0.5% interest rebate for women entrepreneurs (Mahila Samriddhi)
Moratorium period of 3-6 months before repayment starts
Fast-track sanction through State Channelizing Agencies and NBFC-MFIs
applicationProcedure: Submit application to designated State Channelizing Agency (SCA) or empaneled NBFC-MFI
Sanction and disbursement of funds directly to bank account

rules.description: Applicant must belong to Scheduled Caste (SC)
Annual family income must not exceed ₹5,00,000
Suitable for project costs up to ₹1.40 Lakh (with 10% promoter contribution)

name: NSFDC Term Loan Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment (MoSJE)
implementingAgency: National Scheduled Castes Finance and Development Corporation (NSFDC)
targetAudience: Scheduled Caste entrepreneurs setting up small and medium scale enterprises, transport, service or manufacturing units
briefDescription: Substantial financial assistance up to ₹50.00 Lakhs for commercially viable self-employment and entrepreneurial projects.
detailedBenefits: Financial assistance up to 90% of project cost, maximum ₹50.00 Lakhs
Repayment tenure up to 10 years including moratorium period
Moratorium period of 6 to 12 months depending on project gestation
Subsidized interest rate between 6% and 9.5% p.a.
requiredDocuments: Detailed Project Report (DPR) with machinery/cost quotations
PAN Card & Bank Statement for 6 months
applicationProcedure: Submit to State Channelizing Agency (SCA) or participating Public Sector Bank (PSB/RRB)
Technical and financial appraisal by Channel Partner

rules.description: Applicant must belong to Scheduled Caste (SC)
Annual family income must not exceed ₹5,00,000
Designed for capital investments from ₹1 Lakh up to ₹50 Lakhs

name: NSFDC Educational Loan Scheme (Higher & Technical Education)
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment (MoSJE)
implementingAgency: National Scheduled Castes Finance and Development Corporation (NSFDC)
targetAudience: Scheduled Caste students pursuing recognized professional and technical degree/diploma courses in India or abroad
briefDescription: Concessional education loan up to ₹10 Lakhs in India and ₹20 Lakhs abroad at ultra-low interest rates with full study-period moratorium.
detailedBenefits: Up to ₹10 Lakhs for studies in India; up to ₹20 Lakhs for studies abroad
Covers admission fees, books, equipment, hostel & boarding expenses
Concessional interest rate: 4% p.a. for girls/women, 4.5% - 6% p.a. for boys
Moratorium period covers full course duration + 6 months after getting a job or 1 year after course completion
requiredDocuments: Admission letter & Fee Structure from recognized University/College
applicationProcedure: Submit application with college offer letter to nominated SCA or partner bank
Verification of admission credentials and financial eligibility
Direct disbursement of tuition fee to educational institution

rules.description: Applicant must belong to Scheduled Caste (SC)
Annual family income must not exceed ₹5,00,000
Purpose must be recognized higher or technical education

name: Mahila Samriddhi Yojana (MSY)
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment (MoSJE)
implementingAgency: National Scheduled Castes Finance and Development Corporation (NSFDC)
targetAudience: Scheduled Caste women entrepreneurs and women Self-Help Groups (SHGs)
briefDescription: Special micro-finance scheme exclusively for women entrepreneurs belonging to Scheduled Castes with interest rate as low as 4% p.a.
detailedBenefits: Up to ₹1,40,000 per woman beneficiary (or ₹14 Lakhs per SHG of 10 women)
95% project cost funded with minimal margin money
Deep concessional rate of 4% p.a. to end beneficiaries
Flexible repayment terms and simple documentation
requiredDocuments: SHG membership resolution (if applying as group)
applicationProcedure: Apply through local SCA, Rural Bank, or designated Women Development Corporation

rules.description: Applicant must belong to Scheduled Caste (SC)
Beneficiary must be a woman or women SHG
Annual family income must not exceed ₹5,00,000

name: VISVAS Yojana (Vanchit Ikai Samooh Aur Vargon Ki Aarthik Sahayta)
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment (MoSJE)
implementingAgency: National Scheduled Castes Finance and Development Corporation (NSFDC)
targetAudience: SC Self-Help Groups (SHGs) and individual SC borrowers registered with channelizing banks
briefDescription: 5% annual interest subvention directly credited into accounts of SC SHGs and individual micro-credit borrowers.
detailedBenefits: Direct 5% interest subvention transferred via DBT
Eligible on loans up to ₹4.00 Lakhs for SHGs and up to ₹2.00 Lakhs for individual borrowers
Reduces effective borrowing rate to negligible levels for disciplined payers
Covers accounts in good standing across PSBs and RRBs
requiredDocuments: Sanction letter of existing loan from Bank / SCA
applicationProcedure: Bank / Channel partner uploads eligible borrower portfolio
Interest subvention credited quarterly to loan account

rules.description: Borrower or majority SHG members must belong to SC
Annual family income must not exceed ₹5,00,000
